name: once-after-callback
violates: One-shot listeners are cancelled immediately before user code.

name: cancelled-snapshot-runs
violates: A registration cancelled before its turn must be skipped.

name: late-global-snapshot
violates: Both topic and global listener groups are snapshotted before any callback.

name: cloned-payload
violates: Callbacks receive the original payload reference and can observe earlier listener mutations.

name: deduplicated-listeners
old: const entry = { listener, once, active: true };
violates: Every registration is independent, including repeated registration of the same function.

name: swallowed-error
violates: Propagate the exact callback error immediately and stop the current publication.

name: global-before-topic
violates: Matching topic listeners run before global listeners.
